research_scope: Absolute Zero — Ki Blast Evasive / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.history_search: No prior repository research commit for Absolute Zero was found.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Absolute Zero as a Ki Blast Evasive and Counter Skill. The canonical identity therefore remains Evasive / Ki Blast.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Absolute Zero is obtained from Parallel Quest 96 — The Shadow Dragons.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies Eis Shenron as the original user, with Omega Shenron also associated with the technique.
verification_audit.cost_finding: The Evasive Skill reference lists 300 Stamina.
verification_audit.finish_policy: The reviewed evidence establishes PQ96 as the acquisition route but does not explicitly establish an Ultimate Finish requirement for Absolute Zero; therefore ultimate_finish_required remains null.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The user lowers body temperature and enters a counter stance; an attacker during the active period is frozen.

records.name: Absolute Zero
records.skill_description: Abruptly lower your body temperature and touch enemies to freeze them.
records.mechanics_notes: The documented counter stance makes the user immobile while preparing the freezing effect. An opponent who attacks during the active window is frozen. Official-era patch notes also document changes to its hit-detection and freeze timing, so exact behavior should be treated as version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ96 is the documented Future Warrior route. No unsupported drop probability or Ultimate Finish condition is recorded.
records.pve_notes: The counter can punish an attacking opponent with a freeze effect, creating an opening for follow-up actions.
records.pvp_notes: The move is a stance-based counter; historical patch notes show that hit detection and freeze duration have changed, so current frame claims should be versioned.
